generationPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept game asset, transparent world sprite preview. Image 1 role: style and exact material/color identity reference only; create one sphere, not two. Content ID / role: SKILL-014, explosive sphere projectile/world object. Intended use: one slow large projectile launched by Unity and detonated on collision or lifetime; must read at roughly 34–50 screen pixels. View/composition: square master, isolated object, 3/4 top-down gameplay view, centered pivot, one compact near-round sphere fills about 62% of canvas, generous even transparent padding for spin and scale pulse. Style: stylized 2D storybook cutout, hand-drawn, chunky; thick slightly irregular deep-plum outer contour near #241B2B; flat matte dark-violet stone shell in a few large plates, bold orange cracks, warm amber core visible through one central opening; simple cel shading with a broad neutral-warm highlight; very restrained internal glow only inside cracks. Design: one stable readable orb with 5–7 large shell plates; visibly magical and explosive but still a solid projectile. Keep the silhouette round and uncluttered. Output: genuinely transparent background, clean RGBA alpha, no halo, no baked shadow. Avoid: second sphere, detached debris, explosion, fire cloud, smoke, trail, sparks, external particles, ground plane, scene, frame, text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, character, hands, photorealism, 3D render, pixel art, tiny cracks/noisy detail, cropped edges.

operations: Copied the approved candidate byte-identically to v001/concept-01.png and selected-master.png.
Runtime only: alpha-visible bounds x163/y181/x1091/y1096 fitted without distortion inside 192x192 on a transparent 256x256 canvas.
Unity import uses the shared projectile profile: centered pivot, 320 PPU, FullRect, bilinear, clamp, no mipmaps, uncompressed.
Explosion uses a reusable procedural particle burst; no separate explosion raster was generated.
